comparison.objective: Immerse a wafer in a bath for a timed process and return it to heater pins; candidate depins a terminal.
comparison.physical_skill: Pliers grasp, liquid-clearance control, timed immersion and delicate three-pin placement versus recessed latch access and simultaneous tool-wire withdrawal.
comparison.success_condition: One uninterrupted 28–32 second immersion, safe clearances, wafer returned stable and tools controlled; candidate requires selective extraction without damage. Candidate exact thresholds are missing.
comparison.reason: The process-control and placement abilities differ materially from latch release.
